goals.title: Hold the Fort
intro: HAB: New mission! Keep the habitat running for 6 [[sol|sols]].
goals.tryNext: Watch the power arrow. Turn things off before the battery gets low.

goals.title: Rock Hunter
intro: HAB: Scientists on Earth want 3 rock samples. Only samples we keep safe count!

evaCard.prompt: Go outside on an [[eva|EVA]] for a rock sample?

options.label: Go on an EVA
options.hab: Got one! Back inside, safe and sound.

goals.tryNext: Go outside when the sky is calm, and keep enough oxygen for the trip.

goals.title: Keep in Touch
intro: HAB: Earth needs to hear from us on sol 6. Keep the radio working!
goals.tryNext: The radio uses a little power. Turn off other things to save it.
